Ready to start as a delivery driver at Albert Herijn in Almere? Then this is the job for you! Not only do you have flexible working hours, but also a good salary! With an all in salary of € 18,83! NICE! Have you become interested? Then read on!

What we offer
- Salary of € 18,83 per hour (from 21 years)
- Internal training opportunities
- Full-time, and part-time options
- Bring a friend and get € 200!
- Travel expenses and pension plan
- A nice and fun working environment!

Who you are
As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn, you are customer-friendly. Lifting heavy crates up to 15 kilos is no problem for you! What else you need to know about this job:

- You have a B driving license (stick shift);
- You speak Dutch or English;
- You have your own transport to get to the distribution center in Almere

What will you do
As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn, no day is the same. But that makes it fun! You start your day by checking your van. Everything ok? Time to get your tools and delivery routes for the day. Everything will be ready for you at the distribution point. Don't forget to bring something tasty from the fridge for the road! You drive to the addresses by using your navigation. When you arrive at the address of the customer you scan the groceries with the handheld scanner. After delivering the groceries at the doorstep, you handle the payment with your mobile payment device. Did you deliver everything on time? Nice! Then it’s time to return to your colleagues at the distribution center. Ready for a new day!

Working days: Monday to Sunday. It is important that you van work on Monday.
Flexible working hours: rotating between 6:00 AM - 2:00 PM and 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM.

Where will you work
You can find the Albert Heijn distribution center at Wormerweg 10 in Almere. This is easy to reach with your own transport! You and your colleagues leave from this location every day. Get to know them while drinking a cup of coffee together. What makes the work even more fun?

- NEN 9140 Training for Workshop Supervisor English language course: NEN 9140 for Workshop Supervisor For Employers, Health and Safety Officers, and EV Supervisors 
This e-learning explains the NEN 9140 standard and its implications for working on electric vehicles in the workshop. Essential knowledge for the EV work supervisor, as it answers the question: what exactly are your responsibilities? 
 Wil je iets vragen? 
Neem dan contact op met Thomas, onze trainingsspecialist of bel naar 030-6087923 . 
 Training Information 
WHY THE NEN 9140 TRAINING FOR WORKSHOP SUPERVISOR 
In electric vehicles, the propulsion system operates at high voltages. These can pose a danger to people who have to work on these vehicles. The employer is responsible for the safety of the staff. This must ensure a safe workplace and the correct instruction of the staff. For example, an occupational health and safety officer can help with this. The EV workshop supervisor (EV-WV) is the one who is actually in charge of the work on e-vehicles. 
In this e-learning you will learn what the NEN 9140 standard entails and what the standard regulates for those who work on e-vehicles in the workshop. You can see which employees are allowed to perform certain activities and how the designation policy works. You will learn about personal protective equipment and tools, and the usefulness and necessity of instruction and training. 
HOW IS THE TRAINING STRUCTURED? 
The e-learning will be available to you immediately after purchase. The time investment is about 2 hours.
